Definition: a (sacrificial) knife (as gliding through the flesh)
BiblicalUsage: The word names a sacrificial knife, a blade that glides through flesh, and it appears once, in the count of the vessels Cyrus returned to the temple: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, and nine and twenty knives.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the knives were counted when the vessels came home, because God keeps track of the smallest tools of His house.
